xmldoc.short_description: Writes elements into a signal: out = base with out[Indices] = values.

description.p: Writes elements into a signal: out = base with out[Indices] = values.

Writes elements into a signal (Assignment). Port 0 is the base signal; its width sets the output width; port 1 carries the replacement values. Indices (1-based) selects which base elements are overwritten by the successive values: out = base, then out[Indices[k]] = values[k]. Elements not listed pass through unchanged. Simulation-only (vector-shape routing, like reshape / selector): no scalar code-generation path.
